Based on your English major background, here are the most suitable CityUHK programmes:

## Best Matches

**Programme: MA English Studies**

Why it fits:
- The most direct continuation of your English major — it deepens knowledge of English linguistics, literature, and culture
- Builds critical understanding of theory and research, and analyzes language in diverse sociocultural and multilingual contexts
- Prepares you for English language teaching careers or further academic study (e.g., MPhil/PhD)
- Offers a General Track (3 core courses + 6 electives) with flexibility to tailor your studies

Tuition fee: **HK$6,600 per credit** (same for local and non-local students)

**Programme: MA Language Studies**

Why it fits:
- Leverages your language analysis skills from your English major
- Lets you specialize in language structure, language and translation/interpretation, or applied language studies
- Designed to sharpen you as a language professional, with focus on language in Hong Kong's society and culture
- Strong option if you're interested in translation, interpretation, or applied linguistics careers

Tuition fee: **HK$6,600 per credit** (same for local and non-local students)

## Alternative Option (Career Pivot)

**Programme: MA Communication and New Media**

Why it fits:
- All courses are taught in English with emphasis on writing and oral presentations — directly leveraging your English major strengths
- Good pivot if you want to move into media, advertising/PR, content creation, or marketing communication
- Bonus: this programme is selected for the Hong Kong Future Talents Scholarship Scheme (under the 'Digital' priority area), which could reduce your costs

Tuition fee: **HK$7,600 per credit** (same for local and non-local students)

## Comparison Summary

| Programme | Fee per credit | Fit for English major |
|---|---|---|
| MA English Studies | HK$6,600 | Excellent — direct continuation |
| MA Language Studies | HK$6,600 | Excellent — language-focused |
| MA Communication and New Media | HK$7,600 | Good — leverages English skills for media careers |
| MA Chinese and History | HK$7,100 | Limited — focuses on Chinese language/history |
| MSc Marketing | HK$11,650 | Limited — business-oriented, most expensive |

## About Total Cost

The fees above are **per credit unit**. Your total tuition = fee per credit × total credit units required for the programme. The retrieved information doesn't specify the total credit units for each programme, so I recommend checking the individual programme pages for the exact total. 

**My recommendation:** If you want to stay in your field, choose **MA English Studies** (especially for teaching or academia) or **MA Language Studies** (for translation/language professions) — both are the most affordable at HK$6,600 per credit. If you want a career change into media/communications, **MA Communication and New Media** is worth the slightly higher fee, especially with the scholarship opportunity.

Since you didn't specify a programme, here are the entrance requirements for each of the programmes in the retrieved information:

## MSc Energy and Environment
- Must satisfy the [General Entrance Requirements](https://www.cityu.edu.hk/pg/taught-postgraduate-programmes/entrance-requirements), plus:
- An undergraduate degree in **physical sciences or an engineering discipline**. Applicants with degrees in other disciplines may be considered on a case-by-case basis if they have:
  - A-level physics or equivalent attainment, **or**
  - Sufficient working experience in related fields
- **English proficiency** (if your degree was not taught in English):
  - TOEFL: 79 (Internet-based test); or
  - IELTS: overall band score 6.0; or
  - CET-6 (Chinese mainland): 450; or
  - Other equivalent qualifications

## MSocSc Sustainability and Development Studies
- Must satisfy the [General Entrance Requirements](https://www.cityu.edu.hk/pg/taught-postgraduate-programmes/entrance-requirements), plus:
- A Bachelor's degree in a **relevant social sciences discipline** or a **humanities discipline relevant to development studies** from a recognized tertiary institution, or an equivalent qualification
- Applicants with degrees in other fields who possess advanced experience in relevant professions will also be considered
- Advantages (not mandatory): a first degree in social science/humanities; one or more years of working experience in a development-related field
- **English proficiency** (if your degree was not taught in English):
  - TOEFL: 79 (Internet-based test); or
  - IELTS: overall band score 6.0; or
  - Other equivalent qualifications

## MA Creative Media
- Must satisfy the University's General Entrance Requirements for master's programmes (graduate of an accredited bachelor's degree programme or equivalent)
- Both fresh graduates and individuals with relevant industry working experience are invited to apply
- Applicants without the specified qualifications may still be considered if they can present equivalent qualifications; all applicants must demonstrate capacity to pursue the programme
- A basic level of computer literacy is assumed; admitted students may be advised to take intensive or additional courses to fill knowledge/skills gaps
- **English proficiency** (if your degree was not taught in English):
  - TOEFL: 79 (Internet-based test); or
  - IELTS: overall band score 6.0; or
  - CET-6 (Chinese mainland): 500

## MSc Finance
- Must:
  - Hold a bachelor's degree from a recognized university; **and**
  - Preferably possess more than 1 year of work experience in the industry
- **English proficiency** (if your degree was not taught in English):
  - TOEFL: 79 (Internet-based test); or
  - IELTS: overall band score 6.0; or
  - CET-6 (Chinese mainland): 490; or
  - Other equivalent qualifications

## MSc Accounting and Finance with AI and Fintech Applications* (Taught in Chinese)
- Must have:
  - An undergraduate or higher degree in **accounting, finance, or other related disciplines** from an institute recognized by the University or an equivalent qualification; **and**
  - **6 or more years** of related working experience, with at least **two years** relating to accounting or finance operations at the **manager level**
- Exceptionally good applicants who do not meet the above may still be considered based on other outstanding qualities, without compromising programme quality
- **Note:** If you do not hold an accounting/finance degree, or your degree does not include at least two accounting or finance related subjects, you must successfully complete and pass **3 to 5 distance learning professional foundation courses (75 to 125 hours)** offered by BNAI, depending on your circumstances

## Common English Test Notes (all programmes above)
- TOEFL and IELTS scores are valid for **two years**; results must be obtained within the two years preceding the start of the application period
- TOEFL results must be sent directly by ETS to CityUHK (institution code: **3401**)
- IELTS results must be sent via the IELTS Results Service e-delivery
- **Applicants with an IELTS overall band score of 6.0 will be required to pass an English proficiency interview** conducted by the concerned academic unit/Department; interviews for other applicants may not be required
- For MSocSc Sustainability and Development Studies and MA Creative Media: 'TOEFL iBT Home Edition', 'TOEFL MyBest Score', 'IELTS Indicator', 'IELTS One Skill Retake' and 'IELTS Online' are **not acceptable**

Based on your English major background, here are the most suitable CityUHK programmes:

## Best Matches

**Programme: MA English Studies**

Why it fits:
- The most direct continuation of your English major — it deepens knowledge of English linguistics, literature, and culture
- Builds critical understanding of theory and research, and analyzes language in diverse sociocultural and multilingual contexts
- Prepares you for English language teaching careers or further academic study (e.g., MPhil/PhD)
- Offers a General Track (3 core courses + 6 electives) with flexibility to tailor your studies

Tuition fee: **HK$6,600 per credit** (same for local and non-local students)

**Programme: MA Language Studies**

Why it fits:
- Leverages your language analysis skills from your English major
- Lets you specialize in language structure, language and translation/interpretation, or applied language studies
- Designed to sharpen you as a language professional, with focus on language in Hong Kong's society and culture
- Strong option if you're interested in translation, interpretation, or applied linguistics careers

Tuition fee: **HK$6,600 per credit** (same for local and non-local students)

## Alternative Option (Career Pivot)

**Programme: MA Communication and New Media**

Why it fits:
- All courses are taught in English with emphasis on writing and oral presentations — directly leveraging your English major strengths
- Good pivot if you want to move into media, advertising/PR, content creation, or marketing communication
- Bonus: this programme is selected for the Hong Kong Future Talents Scholarship Scheme (under the 'Digital' priority area), which could reduce your costs

Tuition fee: **HK$7,600 per credit** (same for local and non-local students)

## Comparison Summary

| Programme | Fee per credit | Fit for English major |
|---|---|---|
| MA English Studies | HK$6,600 | Excellent — direct continuation |
| MA Language Studies | HK$6,600 | Excellent — language-focused |
| MA Communication and New Media | HK$7,600 | Good — leverages English skills for media careers |
| MA Chinese and History | HK$7,100 | Limited — focuses on Chinese language/history |
| MSc Marketing | HK$11,650 | Limited — business-oriented, most expensive |

## About Total Cost

The fees above are **per credit unit**. Your total tuition = fee per credit × total credit units required for the programme. The retrieved information doesn't specify the total credit units for each programme, so I recommend checking the individual programme pages for the exact total. 

**My recommendation:** If you want to stay in your field, choose **MA English Studies** (especially for teaching or academia) or **MA Language Studies** (for translation/language professions) — both are the most affordable at HK$6,600 per credit. If you want a career change into media/communications, **MA Communication and New Media** is worth the slightly higher fee, especially with the scholarship opportunity.
